title.zh: Skills 注入系统 — core-skills/ + core/src/codex/turn.rs

description.zh: 模拟 Codex Skills 完整注入流程：四层目录发现（Repo > User > System > Admin）→ 隐式注入（render_skills_section() 每轮注入 name+description）→ 用户 $mention 触发显式注入（build_skill_injections() 读取 SKILL.md 全文）→ MCP 依赖自动安装 → 内嵌系统 Skills（编译时打包）。
description.en: Simulate Codex Skills full injection: four-layer discovery (Repo > User > System > Admin) → implicit injection (render_skills_section() per-turn name+description) → $mention triggers explicit injection (build_skill_injections() loads full SKILL.md) → MCP dependency auto-install → bundled system skills.

annotation.zh: loader.rs:243 skill_roots_from_layer_stack_inner() 扫描四层根目录。同名 skill 高优先级覆盖低优先级，支持仓库级 skill 覆盖用户级同名 skill。
annotation.en: loader.rs:243 scans four-layer root directories. Higher priority overrides lower for same-name skills.

steps.content:
// core/src/codex.rs:2417 — 每次 turn 隐式注入
// render_skills_section() 只注入 allow_implicit_invocation=true 的 skills

<skills_instructions>
### Available skills
- imagegen: Generate an image using DALL-E. Triggered when
  user asks to create/draw/generate images.
  (file: ~/.agents/skills/imagegen/SKILL.md)

- auth-helper: Assists with OAuth setup, token management.
  (file: ./.agents/skills/auth-helper/SKILL.md)

- skill-installer: Install skills from GitHub or registry.
  (file: $CODEX_HOME/skills/.system/skill-installer/SKILL.md)

### How to use skills
- If $SkillName OR task matches description → use it
- Open SKILL.md, resolve relative paths from skill directory
</skills_instructions>

annotation.zh: 隐式注入极轻量：只有 name + description + 文件路径，SKILL.md 正文不在此注入。allow_implicit_invocation=false 的 skill 不出现在列表中。
annotation.en: Implicit injection is lightweight: only name + description + file path. Skills with allow_implicit_invocation=false are excluded.

steps.content: 帮我画一只猫在宇宙中 — 使用 $imagegen

annotation.zh: $ 是 TOOL_MENTION_SIGIL。injection.rs:252 extract_tool_mentions_with_sigil() 扫描文本，识别为显式 skill mention，触发显式注入路径。
annotation.en: $ is TOOL_MENTION_SIGIL. injection.rs:252 extract_tool_mentions_with_sigil() identifies explicit skill mention, triggering explicit injection path.

steps.content:
// core/src/codex/turn.rs:210 — build_skill_injections()
// 读取 SKILL.md 全文，以 <skill> XML 注入为 role=user ResponseItem

<skill>
<name>imagegen</name>
<path>~/.agents/skills/imagegen/SKILL.md</path>
---
name: imagegen
description: Generate an image using DALL-E...
---

# Image Generation Skill

## Usage
Use the `image_gen` tool:
```bash
image_gen --prompt "..." --model dall-e-3 --size 1024x1024
```

## Guidelines
- Always confirm the prompt before generating
- Use --model dall-e-3 for best quality
</skill>

annotation.zh: SKILL.md 全文以 <skill>...</skill> XML 结构注入为 role=user 消息，紧接在用户消息之后。模型在本 turn 内完整执行 skill 指令，无需再打开文件。
annotation.en: Full SKILL.md injected as role=user message with <skill>...</skill> XML structure, immediately after user message. Model executes skill instructions in this turn without opening files.

annotation.zh: 模型按 SKILL.md 指令调用 image_gen 工具，使用 SKILL.md 中规定的正确参数格式。Skill 的价值：固化最佳实践，减少用户重复指定参数。
annotation.en: Model calls image_gen tool following SKILL.md instructions with correct parameters. Skill value: codifies best practices, reduces user repetition.

annotation.zh: MCP 依赖自动安装：skill 通过 agents/openai.yaml 声明需要的 MCP server，Codex 自动处理安装和 OAuth，用户体验是一键就绪。
annotation.en: MCP dependency auto-install: skill declares required MCP server in agents/openai.yaml, Codex handles installation and OAuth automatically.
